newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordan approves budget. Finance minister says Jordan's 1997 budget around $2.63 billion.
- Kuwaiti finance minister reported increased capital flow in Kuwait, where the deficit had been reduced to 653 million dinars.
- Some 33 international companies are competing to win oil concessions in Yemen.
- A Saudi economic delegation is to visit Lebanon to examine investment opportunities.
- Saudi Arabia's Arab National Bank decided to grant bonus shares to shareholders in 1996 worth 299 million riyals.
- Markets in Morocco await a half-point interest rate cut in December.
